# ccusage-gauge

> Pure Rust and Tauri v2 macOS menu-bar app, native/browser dashboard, CLI, and local HTTP API that shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex (ChatGPT), and Gemini (Antigravity CLI) subscription limits you have used: the 5-hour and weekly windows as used/remaining percentages with reset countdowns, extra-usage credits, and token/API-equivalent cost history.

Key facts:

- Subscription limit usage (5-hour and weekly windows, used and remaining %, reset time) is read directly from each provider's own usage endpoint using the local Claude Code and Codex CLI logins, and from the local Antigravity CLI status line for Gemini. It is not estimated from token cost.
- Extended usage ("credit"): Claude extra-usage spend against its monthly limit, and Codex credit balance.
- Token counts and API-equivalent cost are scanned and aggregated natively in Rust from local Claude Code JSONL logs, Codex JSONL logs, and Antigravity CLI transcripts (no local `ccusage` CLI installation required), broken down by model, agent, machine, and directory; remote machines are supported over SSH for cost data.
- Menu bar: Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, and Gemini icons fill from bottom to top as usage rises; optional percentages; spend or budget progress; hover tooltip with credits.
- Platforms: single-process Rust + Tauri v2 menu-bar and native dashboard app on macOS (Apple silicon and Intel); CLI and dashboard HTTP server on macOS and Linux.
- Install: `brew install --cask tacogips/tap/ccusage-gauge`.
- Credentials are sent only to the provider's usage endpoint and are never logged, stored, or returned.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md): overview, FAQ, install, configuration
- [Subscription usage and display controls](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md#subscription-usage-and-display-controls): data sources, refresh and throttling behavior, menu-bar and dashboard options, `GET /api/rate-limits` example
- [Remote machines](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md#remote-machines): SSH collection of cost data
- [Dashboard client commands](https://github.com/tacogips/ccusage-gauge/blob/main/README.md#dashboard-client-commands): CLI access to metrics
